The Subtask Name: PRD Creation
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Product Manager
  To_agent: Product Manager
  agent_dependency_type: reasoning_continuation
  agent_strength: 0.95
  agent_explanation: The Product Manager iteratively refines the PRD by adding sections (implementation details, examples) in steps 5-7, building on previous content.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: Misalignment in content insertion (e.g., inserting at wrong line numbers) could corrupt the PRD structure.
      severity: 0.7
      if_from_agent_wrong: The PRD becomes fragmented or contains duplicate/missing sections.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Subsequent agents (Architect, Engineer) may misinterpret requirements due to a malformed document.

- From_agent: Product Manager
  To_agent: Product Manager
  agent_dependency_type: environment_feedback
  agent_strength: 0.85
  agent_explanation: The Product Manager uses file operations (create_file, insert_content_at_line) to persist changes, which serve as environmental feedback for subsequent edits.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Repeated file edits without verifying content could lead to redundant or conflicting updates.
      severity: 0.6
      if_from_agent_wrong: The PRD file grows unnecessarily large or contains contradictory information.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Architect may waste time reconciling inconsistencies in the PRD.

The Subtask Name: System Design
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Architect
  To_agent: Architect
  agent_dependency_type: memory_ref
  agent_strength: 0.90
  agent_explanation: The Architect references the PRD (from Subtask S1) to design the system architecture, ensuring alignment with requirements.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: If the Architect misinterprets the PRD, the system design may deviate from the original goals.
      severity: 0.8
      if_from_agent_wrong: The implementation phase will require significant rework to align with the PRD.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Engineer may implement a solution that fails to meet the product requirements.

- From_agent: Architect

  agent_dependency_type: reasoning_continuation
  agent_strength: 0.88
  agent_explanation: The Architect iteratively refines the system design (e.g., adding diagrams, clarifying flow) based on initial drafts.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Over-refinement without clear milestones could lead to unnecessary iterations.
      severity: 0.5
      if_from_agent_wrong: The design process stalls, delaying the handoff to the Engineer.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Engineer may face delays in starting implementation due to prolonged design discussions.

The Subtask Name: Implementation Assignment
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Team Leader
  To_agent: Team Leader

  agent_strength: 0.92

      if_from_agent_wrong: Agents may work on tasks out of order, leading to dependency conflicts.
